requiredScenarios.requirement: Host descriptor conforms to host-adapter-v1.schema.json and reports only registry capabilities.
Host refuses module activation when its Platform API version is outside the manifest compatibility range.
Missing or unapproved required capability prevents module activation.
Missing optional capability does not prevent activation and remains unavailable to calls.
Every response echoes the UUID of exactly one request; concurrent requests may complete out of order.
Invalid method, parameters, or authorization returns a schema-valid structured error.
Host events use unique event IDs and schema-valid event envelopes.
Module identity and verified manifest are bound by Host session creation, never trusted from request parameters.
Every call checks method registry, manifest declaration, Host support, and current user consent.
One module session cannot read or mutate another module's storage namespace.
Revoked consent blocks subsequent calls even when the manifest still declares the capability.
Messages exceeding the advertised limit are rejected before dispatch.
A timed-out request has one terminal outcome; a late result is not delivered as a second response.
Closing a module session more than once is safe and does not resurrect the runtime.
